description: W12 coding smoke eval task set (docs/STRATEGY.md §3a). Each task ships a prompt shown to the candidate model, a starter.py stub, a hidden checks.py (pytest), and a reference_solution.py used only by --offline canned runs / task self-tests -- never shown to the candidate model.

tasks.title: Clamp scores into a range (pure function, edge cases)
